function.arguments: {"sql": "SELECT t.table_name, c.column_name, c.data_type FROM information_schema.tables t JOIN information_schema.columns c ON c.table_schema=t.table_schema AND c.table_name=t.table_name WHERE t.table_schema='public' ORDER BY t.table_name, c.ordinal_position;"}
